title: CBEPointInTimeEventSchema
description: Standardized causal point-in-time financial and macroeconomic event schema for Coin Behavior Engine historical research.

published_at_utc.description: Nominal publication or press release timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC.

available_at_utc.description: Earliest timestamp at which the event was deterministically ingestible by an algorithmic consumer without lookahead bias.

category.description: Primary taxonomy classification for financial market impact.

raw_text.description: Original text body, summary snippet, or official press excerpt.

entities.description: Recognized financial and economic entities (e.g., BTC, FED, SEC, BINANCE, CPI).

sentiment_score.description: Normalized point-in-time sentiment score bounded in [-1.0, 1.0].

expected_value.description: Consensus market expectation prior to release (null if not a quantitative macroeconomic release).

actual_value.description: Released actual value corresponding to this vintage.

previous_value.description: Previous period released value as understood at this vintage.

revision_indicator.description: True if this record represents a subsequent revision of an earlier release period.

vintage_date.description: ALFRED vintage date (YYYY-MM-DD) determining point-in-time availability.

is_first_release.description: True if this is the initial unrevised data release available at T_0.

causal_delay_seconds.description: Enforced ingestion delay in seconds (e.g., 60 for economic releases, 300 for news wire syndications).

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of canonical event contents (event_id + raw_text + published_at_utc).

causal_rules.simulation_eligibility: Event is visible in bar ending at T_bar if and only if available_at_utc <= T_bar
causal_rules.revision_handling: Every revision creates a distinct event_id with is_first_release=false and its own available_at_utc

example_events.headline: US May 2022 CPI Accelerates to 8.6% Year-over-Year, Highest Since 1981
example_events.raw_text: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 1.0 percent in May on a seasonally adjusted basis after rising 0.3 percent in April. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 8.6 percent before seasonal adjustment.

example_events.headline: SEC Approves Accelerated Listing of 11 Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Products
example_events.raw_text: The Securities and Exchange Commission today approved the accelerated registration and listing applications for 11 spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds on NYSE Arca, Nasdaq, and Cboe BZX.
